text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein allows Iranians to visit holy shrines in Iraq.
- President chairs meeting of governors of provinces and directors-general of Interior Ministry.
- Culture and Information Ministry source rebuts Iranian allegation that Baghdad still holds Iranian POWs.
- Work continuing to load international supertankers with Iraqi oil from Mina al-Bakr and Ceyhan ports.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
